book.title: 海浪为什么一下一下
book.subtitle: 风把能量送来，海面便跳起舞
book.question: 海浪为什么一下一下？

moral.zh: 风把能量传给水面，波浪把能量一下一下传向岸边，浅水处便变陡破碎。
moral.en: Wind gives energy to the sea, and waves carry that energy toward shore before breaking in shallow water.

pages.enText: At the beach, Xiao He watched the foam and asked, “Why do waves come one after another?”

pages.enText: A breeze swept in. Shiny wave crests rolled toward the sand, again and again.

pages.enText: Mother explained, “The wind gives energy to the water’s surface, making ripples grow.”

pages.enText: Tiny bits of water near the surface move up, down, forward, and back, almost tracing little circles in place.

pages.enText: Near shallow water, the seafloor slows the waves. They grow steeper, then tumble into foamy breakers.

pages.enText: Xiao He nodded. “So the whole ocean is not rushing in—the energy is traveling!”

pages.enText: Then Xiao He asked, “Why does the tide rise and fall?” Mother smiled.
